title: Studio
description: Agents make single assets here: a 3D model, a render, or an image, shaped by your feedback.

grid.label: Studio items
grid.loadError: Studio items could not be loaded.
grid.empty: No items yet. Start one with New item.

noStorage.title: Studio needs a storage location
noStorage.body: Every file an agent makes is kept in a storage location. Add one under Settings, Storage, then come back to start an item.

create.title: New Studio item
create.promptHint: Describe the asset. The agent starts on it as soon as the item is created.
create.itemTitleHint: Optional. Left blank, the item is named after the start of the prompt.
create.projectHint: Optional. With a project, the agent can read and propose changes to its action items.
create.locationHint: Where every file of the item is kept.
create.noLocationForProject: No storage location saves files for this project or for every project.
create.noLocationForEveryProject: No storage location saves files for every project. Choose a project, or link a location to every project under Settings, Storage.

errors.promptRequired: Describe what the agent should make.
errors.locationRequired: Choose where the item's files are kept.
errors.satelliteRequired: Choose a satellite to run the agent.

item.missing: This item does not exist, or was deleted for good.
item.loadError: The item could not be loaded.
item.deletedBody: It stays read-only until it is restored. Its files and conversation are kept.
item.pullError: The latest file could not be kept: {{reason}}

layout.label: Show
layout.resize: Resize the preview and the conversation

stage.empty: Nothing to show yet. Files appear here as the agent delivers them.
stage.emptyWorking: The agent is working. Files appear here as it delivers them.
stage.noPreview: This model has no preview. Download it below.
stage.annotateHint: Draw over this view to show the agent what to change

toasts.pinned: The tile now shows this image.
toasts.unpinned: The tile shows its default image again.
toasts.pinFailed: The thumbnail could not be changed.

viewer.label: 3D view of {{name}}
viewer.loadError: This model could not be shown. Download it instead.
viewer.captureFailed: The current view could not be captured.

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.promptHint: The agent sees your drawing over this view, with what you write here.
annotate.loadError: The image could not be opened for drawing.

conversation.label: Conversation
conversation.empty: The conversation starts once the agent picks up the first prompt.
conversation.loadError: This part of the conversation could not be loaded.
conversation.continuedImported: Continued in a new thread, which resumed the agent's own conversation
conversation.continuedBrief: Continued in a new thread, which started from a brief of the item so far
conversation.threadEnded: This item's thread has ended. Sending continues it in a new thread.

delete.title: Delete {{title}}?
delete.body: The item leaves the grid and its thread stops. You can restore it from Deleted items.
delete.permanently: Also permanently delete its files, conversation, and agent memory

toasts.createFailed: The item could not be started.
toasts.sendFailed: The prompt could not be sent.
toasts.deleteFailed: The item could not be deleted.
toasts.restoreFailed: The item could not be restored.
toasts.renameFailed: The title could not be saved.
